searches._note: streams live right now: the Apps Script counts their chat live (pollLive)

youtube._quota_note: Scout: 7 searches x 100 + ~20 list calls per run, 4 runs/day = ~2,900 units. Tracker: ~1 unit per 50 videos per run.

gemini._note: Free tier caps are small and change often (Nov 2026: Flash ~20 requests/day, Flash-Lite more; max 8 h of YouTube video/day). Check AI Studio and edit here; code never assumes. Models are tried in order; an unknown name falls through to the next.

watcher._fallback_note: If Flash is busy (503) a request falls back to Flash-Lite instead of wasting the call.
watcher._budget_note: daily_budget = Flash calls (15). Flash-Lite fallback has its own 30/day (model_budgets). Runs use at most max_calls_per_run to stay inside free GitHub minutes.

researcher._note: Flash-Lite has a much higher free limit than Flash (~500/day reported, shared with the Watcher's 30 fallback calls and the Decider). Own counter: data/gemini_usage_researcher.json

decider._note: One text-only call per evening batch (+ retries). Own counter data/gemini_usage_decider.json.

batch._note: auto_approve: new Batch rows get approved=yes, so the render runs without a click. The owner glances at each clip while uploading to YouTube; type "no" in approved to stop one.
batch._ramp_note: Owner's choice (2026-11-17): 5 clips per brand every day from Nov 18, no ramp. Add {"YYYY-MM-DD": n} entries here to change the number from a date on.

edits._note: Editing pack (lib/edits.py). Playbook findings (research.now.* then research.*) override these defaults per effect. remove_music = Demucs (slow, Colab).
edits._experiments_note: Skills under test: each goes on this share of clips at random (stable per clip); template_version tags (shake/freeze) let the Analyst compare our own posts with vs without.
edits._new_skills_note: deadair (dead-air cutter) and memesfx (boom / ding on the payoff) are built but OFF (0.0) until the owner has tested them on real clips (render notebook cell 5: TEST_SKILLS); switch on with 1.0.

style_defaults._note: Used until the Researcher has enough analysed winners; then Playbook style.* rows decide (lib/style.py).

reframe._note: lib/reframe.py: full-screen crops follow the action; clips with a streamer facecam get a split-screen (facecam on top) on split_share of clips (experiment, tag 'split'). Needs OpenCV (preinstalled in Colab).

researcher._note: Daily study of GTA 6 Shorts 3-14 days old (settled) + twice-daily fresh tier 0-72 h (what works right now): winners vs average -> Playbook tab (research.*, research.now.*).

fresh._note: Shorts 0-72 h old, ranked by views/hour within the same age bucket (+ channel-size bonus). Scout's Shorts are added free. ~400 units per run.

baseline._note: Winner = beat its OWN channel's normal Short views (lib/baselines.py), not raw views. Cache data/channel_baselines.json.

researcher._skill_group_note: Viral tricks, Examples, gap report, style, story shape and clip length come only from Shorts of this format group (lib/formats.py): stream clips. Falls back to all formats while < min_group winners are tagged.

examples._note: Examples tab: top `tricks` viral-right-now tricks x `per_trick` example Shorts + `top` breakouts (lib/examples.py).
examples._alert_note: alerts.new_trick: the best viral trick we can't do yet if it is in the top `alert_top`, with `alert_links` example links and `since` (first day of the alert); the daily skill scout tells the owner.

deep._note: mode deep: no YouTube; analyse collected Shorts (winners first, then comparison groups, then backfill of new tags). Scheduled every 3 h when repo variable DEEP_RESEARCH = on.

decider._trick_fit_note: score += weight x (trick_fit - 5): fit 10 = +0.5, fit 1 = -0.4 (quality 1-10 still decides)
